Company.title: Company Profile | ILPR Maril
Company.p-1: ILPR Maril Inc. is a US real estate and tourism company headquartered in Miami, Florida, led by CEO Semon Oguz. The ILPR team's goal is to scale a profitable and socially sustainable business model internationally together with its investors and partners.
Company.p-2: ILPR is evolving the dated image of hotel and resort concepts as well as classic vacation hospitality into exclusive models for recreation, hospitality, assisted living, spa and rehabilitation offerings, and long-term residential and investment models.
Company.p-3: From the sun-drenched Turkish Aegean, through vibrant Florida, to the glamorous Côte d'Azur, we develop, operate, and plan accessible luxury resorts in world-class locations where tourism magic, first-class medical infrastructure, and sustainable value creation form a perfect triangle: places that not only make vacation dreams come true but also secure quality of life for generations.
Company.approach-p-1: Founded by one of Turkey's greatest visionaries with decades of expertise in construction, tourism, healthcare, and international sales, ILPR Maril Inc. unites the highest project development standards, innovative construction and operating expertise, infrastructure for top-tier medical care, and a global network of strong partners under one roof.
Company.approach-p-2: This creates properties of timeless elegance and smart functionality that appeal equally to discerning vacationers, affluent spa guests, exclusive travel groups, long-term visitors, leading tour operators and booking portals, as well as real estate agents, financial institutions, and institutional investors – every project a milestone combining the highest return expectations with unmatched joie de vivre.
Company.approach-p-3: As a forward-looking platform, ILPR Maril Inc. relies on unparalleled brand power, scalable concepts, and deeply rooted local partnerships, complemented by an uncompromising commitment to sustainability, comprehensive accessibility, and world-class service quality.
Company.approach-p-4: Our hotels and resorts are more than buildings – they are centers and havens of recreation, recovery, and enjoyment, and you, dear reader, are always warmly invited to visit us and see what we have built.

CSR.title: CSR & Responsibility | ILPR Maril
CSR.description: Corporate social responsibility and sustainability are essential pillars of our company. Learn more about our responsibility as ILPR Maril.
CSR.intro: For us, sustainability means more than environmental protection: it is the foundation of every business decision.
CSR.p-1: ILPR Maril Inc. views sustainability and social responsibility as an integral part of its business model. As an operator and developer of resorts in internationally sought-after regions, we bear a special responsibility toward the environment, employees, guests, and the local communities in which we operate.
CSR.p-2: At the heart of our approach is the respectful use of natural resources, the protection of coastal and marine areas, and the preservation of biodiversity at our locations. To this end, we work in France, Turkey, and the USA almost exclusively with partners who demonstrably commit to protecting nature, wildlife, and especially insects, in order to safeguard sensitive ecosystems – from beaches to dune landscapes to the habitats of important pollinators – for the long term.
CSR.p-3: At the same time, we place great value on fair working conditions, training and development opportunities for our employees, and close involvement of local partners, service providers, and producers. Our goal is to develop projects that are economically successful while making a positive contribution to the environment, society, and future generations. We therefore understand social responsibility not as a single project, but as an ongoing process considered in every phase – from planning through to day-to-day operations.
CSR.p-4: That is why we support local conservation organizations in France, Turkey, and the USA – and we would be delighted if you took a look at these organizations' websites. By the way: if, after visiting our partners' websites, you decide to support them with a donation, let us know – we will match your donation.

BusinessModel.title: Business Model | ILPR Maril
BusinessModel.intro: We plan, develop, operate, and market luxury resorts in the world's most attractive coastal regions.
BusinessModel.p-1: Our business model is as simple as it is transparent: we plan, develop, build, operate, market, and sell exclusive land, real estate, hotels, and spa and vacation properties. These are designed with a particular focus on current and future demographic developments and the rapidly growing aging population.
BusinessModel.p-2: Our acronym ILPR stands for our business divisions: International Land, Property and Resorts, and our CEO, Simon Oguz, has stood for decades of long-term, successful business activity in the real estate and tourism sectors.
BusinessModel.p-3: ILPR's goal is to build and operate accessible luxury resorts in the world's most attractive coastal regions and to develop an integrated, high-yield hospitality ecosystem for guests, partners, and investors. In locations such as the Turkish Aegean, the Côte d'Azur, or Florida, we combine classic vacation hospitality, assisted living, spa and rehabilitation offerings, and long-stay concepts into a coherent business model that is future-proof, generates year-round demand, and is significantly less affected by seasonal fluctuations and location-specific risks.

Buyers.title: Property Buyers | ILPR Maril
Buyers.h1: Your key to a worry-free future
Buyers.intro: Discover your benefits as a property buyer with ILPR Maril
paragraphs: If you want the utmost comfort along with a safe, accessible, and health-promoting environment, then you, your partner, and your family have come to the right place. ILPR Maril Inc. offers exceptionally flexible ways to invest in comfortable apartments, bungalows, and other properties: acquire a stake, purchase one outright, rent it for personal use, or purchase it and let us rent it out on your behalf – or combine these models to suit your wishes and needs.

Our apartments in the Maril Group's properties – from Maril Resort Beach & Spa on the Turkish Aegean to planned projects on the Côte d'Azur and other locations – combine the appeal of an exclusive location with a professional operating model: as an investment, you can purchase a single, duplex, or individual apartment within the hotel or resort, and as the legal owner, you can not only live there yourself but also have it profitably rented out and managed by us.

Whether you want to use our properties as a permanent guest or spend six months of the year there yourself and rent it out for the other six months – with us and our flexible models, you don't have to choose! Rest assured that neither your wishes regarding location, culture, and entertainment options, nor reliable models for marketing, rental, maintenance, or occupancy, will go unfulfilled.

Each Maril location handles all operational tasks: from presence on all relevant booking and review portals (e.g., Booking, Expedia, HolidayCheck), through dynamic pricing, to cleaning, guest care, and ongoing maintenance.

The units can be used flexibly, either for personal use or purely as a capital investment – in both cases the owner benefits from strong tourist demand, spa guests, and the positioning in a growth region on the Aegean, in the premium segment of the Côte d'Azur, and in the greater Miami, Florida area.

CompanyFAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions | ILPR Maril
CompanyFAQ.description: Get in touch with ILPR Maril now.
CompanyFAQ.intro: Here you will find frequently asked questions and answers about ILPR Maril.
CompanyFAQ.faq-1-q: Where in Turkey is the Maril Hotel located?
CompanyFAQ.faq-1-a: The Maril Hotel is located in Didim on Turkey's Aegean coast. The location combines a coastal setting, resort character, and good conditions for vacation, relaxation, and health-oriented stays in Turkey.
CompanyFAQ.faq-2-q: Is the Maril Hotel Didim an existing location?
CompanyFAQ.faq-2-a: Yes. The Maril Hotel Didim is the existing Maril location on the Turkish Aegean coast. ILPR Maril lists Hotel Maril Didim in its 2021 project overview. You can book a room directly through the hotel website or via Booking.com and similar platforms!
CompanyFAQ.faq-3-q: Which Maril locations are planned besides Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-3-a: In addition to the existing Didim location, Nice on the Côte d'Azur, Miami in Florida, and Istanbul in Turkey are planned as further Maril locations. Once we receive the official ILPR Maril office address in Wilmington, Delaware, as well as the shared office in Florida, the addresses will be added to our website.
CompanyFAQ.faq-4-q: What is the Maril concept, particularly regarding accessible tourism and resort operations?
CompanyFAQ.faq-4-a: The Maril concept combines vacation hospitality, resort operations, accessibility, and health-oriented stays. This makes Maril appealing both to classic vacation guests and families, as well as to guests with specific comfort, service, or mobility needs.
CompanyFAQ.faq-5-q: Which guests is the Maril Hotel Didim suitable for?
CompanyFAQ.faq-5-a: At ILPR Maril, every guest is at the center. Maril is suitable for vacationers, business travelers, couples, families, older travelers, and people with mobility needs. The location is designed for guests seeking relaxation, comfort, service, and a well-accessible resort environment. More information is available on our website.
CompanyFAQ.faq-6-q: Is Maril a classic vacation hotel or an expanded resort concept?
CompanyFAQ.faq-6-a: Maril is more than a classic vacation hotel. The concept combines hotel operations, resort stays, accessibility, health-oriented services, and international location development into an expanded hospitality model.
CompanyFAQ.faq-7-q: How is Maril positioned when it comes to accessibility?
CompanyFAQ.faq-7-a: ILPR Maril places a particular focus on accessible tourism. Guests with specific mobility needs should clarify directly before booking which rooms, pathways, and services at the Didim location are suitable for their individual requirements. More information is available on our website.
CompanyFAQ.faq-8-q: Can I request an accessible room at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-8-a: Yes, guests with mobility needs should request a low-barrier or particularly accessible room before booking. The hotel can then determine which room category and location are suitable for the specific need. You can direct specific questions to your tour operator or our booking specialists.
CompanyFAQ.faq-9-q: Can I communicate wheelchair, walker, or other mobility needs before arrival?
CompanyFAQ.faq-9-a: Yes. Guests can communicate wheelchair, walker, or other mobility needs before arrival. The more precise the details, the better the room location, access, transfer, service, and other support during the stay can be reviewed and prepared.
CompanyFAQ.faq-10-q: Are public areas at the Maril Hotel Didim easily accessible?
CompanyFAQ.faq-10-a: Maril places value on well-accessible hotel and resort areas. Since needs can vary greatly, guests should specifically ask before booking whether the restaurant, lobby, pool area, elevators, and pathways are suitable for their individual needs.
CompanyFAQ.faq-11-q: Is the Maril Hotel Didim suitable for seniors and older guests?
CompanyFAQ.faq-11-a: The Maril Hotel Didim is also suitable for older guests seeking relaxation, comfort, and a well-accessible hotel environment. Special requirements regarding room location, pathways, support, or mobility should be coordinated before arrival.
CompanyFAQ.faq-12-q: Can I book a longer stay at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-12-a: Longer stays can be requested depending on the season, room category, and availability. For a suitable offer, travel dates, length of stay, desired meal plan, room category, and any special requirements are important. Our specialists are happy to provide individual advice and booking support on our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de).
CompanyFAQ.faq-13-q: Does ILPR Maril Inc. offer spa, rehabilitation, or health-related stays?
CompanyFAQ.faq-13-a: Yes. Some Maril Group properties already offer wellness, therapy, and non-medical spa treatments. In Didim, doctors, therapists, and nursing staff are also available on-site. Further expansion of medically supervised spa and rehabilitation offerings is planned.
CompanyFAQ.faq-14-q: What offerings does ILPR Maril plan for care facilities?
CompanyFAQ.faq-14-a: ILPR Maril plans accessible recreation and respite stays for care facilities, assisted living communities, and geriatric institutions. Stays ranging from two weeks to six months are planned, with continuous care by qualified local nursing and specialist staff available on request. The offering is intended to provide support especially during renovations, staff shortages, or temporary capacity needs.
CompanyFAQ.faq-15-q: What medical partnerships does ILPR Maril plan?
CompanyFAQ.faq-15-a: ILPR Maril plans cooperation models for specialist physicians, clinics, rehabilitation centers, and medical care networks. Accessible stay, rehabilitation, and recreation offerings are planned for patients, along with separate accommodation options for accompanying nursing staff. In the future, agreements with national and international health insurers are also to be pursued.
CompanyFAQ.faq-16-q: What room categories are available at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-16-a: The Maril Hotel Didim offers spacious rooms and suites in various categories, from generously sized single and double rooms to suites and family rooms. All rooms feature a balcony or terrace. Depending on the room location, guests may enjoy views of the sea, the mountains, or Didim with a partial view of the coast and hilly landscape. The rooms are deliberately designed to avoid a typical backyard view, creating an open and high-quality atmosphere.
CompanyFAQ.faq-17-q: Can I request a specific room or location at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-17-a: A specific room, floor, sea view, proximity to the pool or elevator, or a quiet location can be requested. Final confirmation depends on availability, room category, booking time, and operational processes. Room categories can be selected through your tour operator or directly on our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/rooms).
CompanyFAQ.faq-18-q: Are there family rooms or larger rooms at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-18-a: Yes. The Maril Hotel Didim offers family rooms and larger room solutions, depending on category and availability. Families, groups, or several people traveling together are advised to make a direct inquiry with number of guests, travel dates, and desired room configuration via our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/rooms).
CompanyFAQ.faq-19-q: Are there suites or upscale room categories at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-19-a: Depending on availability, larger or upscale room categories are also available at the Maril Hotel Didim. Details on size, balcony, view, and amenities can be found based on the selected room category via your tour operator or directly on our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/rooms).
CompanyFAQ.faq-20-q: How can I book the Maril Hotel Didim online or directly?
CompanyFAQ.faq-20-a: The Maril Hotel Didim can be requested or booked through official contact channels. These include the Maril website (https://marilresort.com.tr/en) and our partner portals Booking.com, Hotels.com, Altours.com, Tui.com, and 12travel.de.
CompanyFAQ.faq-21-q: Can I request multiple rooms or a group booking at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-21-a: Yes, multiple rooms or group bookings can be requested depending on room category and availability. For travel groups, families, companies, partners, or longer stays, please submit a request to the Maril team via our website (https://ilpr-maril.vercel.app/de/netzwerk).
CompanyFAQ.faq-22-q: From what time is check-in possible at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-22-a: Check-in time is based on the booking conditions. Please refer to your booking confirmation for exact check-in and check-out times. Guests arriving earlier or requiring special assistance should contact their tour operator or booking portal before arrival.
CompanyFAQ.faq-23-q: Is late check-out possible at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-23-a: Late check-out can be requested at the reception or before arrival. Whether it is possible and whether additional costs apply depends on occupancy, room category, and same-day arrivals, and can be requested at the hotel reception on-site.
CompanyFAQ.faq-24-q: Can I send my details to Maril before arrival?
CompanyFAQ.faq-24-a: Yes. Guests can communicate important information such as arrival time, special requests, mobility needs, or contact details before arrival. This makes preparing for the stay easier and can speed up check-in on-site.
CompanyFAQ.faq-25-q: What documents do I need for check-in at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-25-a: Check-in generally requires a valid passport or ID card, the booking confirmation, and, if applicable, a credit card or payment confirmation from the relevant booking portal. Additional statutory registration information may be required for international guests.
CompanyFAQ.faq-26-q: What payment methods does the Maril Hotel Didim accept?
CompanyFAQ.faq-26-a:
At the Maril Hotel Didim, guests can pay with common credit cards. According to information from major booking platforms, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, or cash payment are among those accepted.

Which payment method is available in each case depends on the booking channel, the selected rate, and the applicable reservation terms. Exact payment information can be found in the guest's booking confirmation or on the respective booking portal.
CompanyFAQ.faq-27-q: Can I pay for my stay at the Maril Hotel Didim before arrival?
CompanyFAQ.faq-27-a:
Yes, depending on the booking channel and selected rate, payment before arrival may be possible. For certain offers, special rates, longer stays, or group bookings, a deposit or advance payment may also be required.

The exact payment deadlines, amounts, and conditions are determined by the relevant offer, the hotel's direct reservation confirmation, or the information provided by the booking portal used.
CompanyFAQ.faq-28-q: Do I need to provide a credit card when booking at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-28-a: Whether a credit card must be provided at the time of booking depends on the chosen booking channel, rate, and payment model. For certain bookings, a credit card may be required as a booking guarantee, advance payment, or to secure additional services. The applicable payment terms are shown during the booking process or on the booking portal used.
CompanyFAQ.faq-29-q: Is a deposit required for the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-29-a: A deposit may be required depending on the rate, season, length of stay, room category, group booking, or special offer. The amount, deadline, and payment method are specified in the relevant offer or booking confirmation.
CompanyFAQ.faq-30-q: Are taxes, local fees, or tourism levies included in the Maril hotel price?
CompanyFAQ.faq-30-a: Whether taxes, local fees, or tourism levies are included in the price depends on the booking channel, stay model, and applicable regulations. For international guests, different price components may be visible depending on country of origin, payment method, platform, or local regulations. The price overview shown before booking completion is decisive.
CompanyFAQ.faq-31-q: Can I change or rebook my Maril hotel reservation?
CompanyFAQ.faq-31-a: Booking changes depend on the booked rate, availability, and applicable conditions. Changes to travel date, length of stay, room category, or number of guests are coordinated directly with the hotel or the relevant booking channel.
CompanyFAQ.faq-32-q: What cancellation policies apply at the Maril Hotel?
CompanyFAQ.faq-32-a: Cancellation policies depend on the booked rate. Flexible rates, non-refundable rates, group bookings, special offers, and longer stays may have different deadlines, fees, and refund rules. Please refer to your booking on the relevant booking portal.
CompanyFAQ.faq-33-q: What happens if I don't arrive, or am unable to arrive?
CompanyFAQ.faq-33-a: In the case of a no-show without timely cancellation, no-show fees or cancellation costs may apply depending on the rate, booking channel, and confirmed conditions. Guests should therefore check early which cancellation policy applies to their specific booking.
CompanyFAQ.faq-34-q: Does the Maril Hotel Didim offer flexible and non-refundable rates?
CompanyFAQ.faq-34-a: Yes, flexible and non-refundable rates may be available depending on the offer. Flexible rates offer more room for changes or cancellation, while non-refundable rates are often tied to advance payment and stricter conditions.
CompanyFAQ.faq-35-q: Is breakfast included at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-35-a: Breakfast may be included or bookable separately depending on the rate, room category, and booked service package. Guests can see the exact meal plan in their offer on the booking portal, in the booking confirmation, or upon request at the hotel. Of course, breakfast can also be booked additionally on-site at the hotel – please contact the friendly staff at the hotel reception.
CompanyFAQ.faq-36-q: Is half board available at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-36-a: Yes. Half board is available for booking at the Maril Beach & Spa Hotel. Guests should check before booking (https://marilresort.com.tr/en/contact) which meals, drinks, and times are included in the specific rate.
CompanyFAQ.faq-37-q: Is full board or all-inclusive available at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-37-a: Yes. The Maril Beach & Spa Hotel offers a 24-hour all-inclusive concept from April 1 to October 31. Guests should check before booking which meals, drinks, and times are included in the specific rate.
CompanyFAQ.faq-38-q: Are vegetarian, vegan, or allergy-friendly meals available at the Maril Hotel?
CompanyFAQ.faq-38-a: Vegetarian meals can be accommodated in the restaurant offering. Vegan diets, allergies, intolerances, gluten-free meals, or other special diets are best coordinated with the hotel before arrival.
CompanyFAQ.faq-39-q: Can Maril accommodate allergies and food intolerances?
CompanyFAQ.faq-39-a: Yes, allergies and intolerances can be reviewed after prior notification. Guests should indicate affected foods, allergy severity, and any special requirements as early as possible so the kitchen and service team can determine suitable options.
CompanyFAQ.faq-40-q: Can non-hotel guests use the restaurant at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-40-a: Whether external guests can use the restaurant depends on occupancy and reservation levels. During high occupancy, the restaurant may be primarily reserved for hotel guests.
CompanyFAQ.faq-41-q: Is there a pool at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-41-a: A pool is an important amenity for a resort on the Turkish Aegean coast, and it is located directly behind the lobby, usable for both children and adults. Usage, opening hours, pool rules, towels, sun loungers, and accessibility can easily be inquired about at the hotel information desk.
CompanyFAQ.faq-42-q: Is there wellness, spa, or health services at the Maril Resort?
CompanyFAQ.faq-42-a: Wellness, spa, or health-oriented offerings such as massages and a fitness studio are part of the Maril resort concept. Specific availability, opening hours, treatments, prices, and any partner services depend on your booked service package. You can conveniently check availability or book additional services on our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/spa-wellness) or on-site at the hotel reception.
CompanyFAQ.faq-43-q: Are there fitness or exercise facilities at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-43-a: The fitness studio is included for our vacation guests and is located in the lower level of the Maril Hotel Didim, along with numerous saunas and other health-promoting amenities. Specific equipment and class availability depend on current seasonal occupancy but can be inquired about at the reception or via our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/spa-wellness).
CompanyFAQ.faq-44-q: Are pool towels or beach towels provided at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-44-a: Pool or beach towels may be included or available for a fee, depending on the hotel standard, season, and booked offer. Information on issuance, exchange, deposit, and return is available from the hotel's on-site information desk.
CompanyFAQ.faq-45-q: Are sun loungers and parasols included at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-45-a: Yes, sun loungers and parasols are included for the pool area. Guests receive binding information on access and opening hours from the relevant booking or hotel information desk.
CompanyFAQ.faq-46-q: Is free Wi-Fi available at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-46-a: Wi-Fi is one of the most important basic amenities for hotel guests and international visitors. The Maril hotel group provides all its guests with free, fast Wi-Fi that is available throughout the entire property. Access to the free Wi-Fi is provided upon arrival at the hotel information desk.
CompanyFAQ.faq-47-q: Is parking available at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-47-a: Information on parking at the Maril Hotel Didim should be requested directly from the hotel before arrival. Whether parking is available, free, or subject to a fee may vary depending on season, occupancy, and booking situation.
CompanyFAQ.faq-48-q: Is there an airport transfer to the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-48-a: An airport transfer to the Maril Hotel Didim may be offered depending on the tour operator, booking platform, rate, and availability. Please check transfer options directly with your booking platform, tour operator, or via our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact).
CompanyFAQ.faq-49-q: Does Maril offer a shuttle service in Didim or the surrounding area?
CompanyFAQ.faq-49-a: A shuttle service in Didim or the surrounding area may be offered depending on season, availability, and booked offer. Whether the shuttle service is free or subject to a fee, and which destinations are served, should be inquired about in advance directly via the hotel website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact), the tour operator, or the booking platform.
CompanyFAQ.faq-50-q: Are pets allowed at the Maril Hotel, and what rules apply?
CompanyFAQ.faq-50-a: No, pets are not permitted at our hotels.
CompanyFAQ.faq-51-q: Are there non-smoking rooms at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-51-a: Yes, smoking is not permitted inside rooms at the Maril Hotel. Please ask your tour operator or the Maril hotel information desk on-site where smoking areas are located on the hotel grounds.
CompanyFAQ.faq-52-q: Are there designated smoking areas at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-52-a: Smoking is only permitted in designated areas, in accordance with the local regulations of the respective Maril location. Please refer to the hotel information desk or the relevant guidelines for rooms, balconies, indoor areas, outdoor areas, and common areas.
CompanyFAQ.faq-53-q: What should I do if I have lost something at the Maril Hotel?
CompanyFAQ.faq-53-a: Guests should contact Maril as soon as possible with their booking number, stay dates, room number, and a description of the lost item. The hotel will carefully check internally and get back to you as soon as your lost item can be identified.
CompanyFAQ.faq-54-q: What house rules apply at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-54-a: Guests of the Maril Hotel Didim are subject to the currently applicable hotel rules, safety regulations, and local requirements. These may affect the use of rooms, restaurant, spa, pool, and beach areas, among others. Binding information on house rules is available on-site at reception or directly from the hotel in advance.
CompanyFAQ.faq-55-q: Can I request multiple rooms or a group trip with Maril?
CompanyFAQ.faq-55-a: Yes. A direct request for multiple rooms, group trips, corporate stays, or events can be submitted to the Maril Hotel Didim. The hotel has 192 rooms and 610 beds in various categories. Terms and availability depend on season, group size, length of stay, and desired scope of services. You can learn more on our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/rooms).
CompanyFAQ.faq-56-q: Are there event or meeting rooms at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-56-a: Yes. The Maril Hotel Didim has a 400 m² meeting and event space that can accommodate up to 350 people, depending on requirements and hotel management specifications. Please direct inquiries regarding date, seating, technology, catering, and availability directly to the hotel via our contact page (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact).
CompanyFAQ.faq-57-q: Can I host private parties or events at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-57-a: Private parties or events may be possible depending on season, room availability, and house rules. The hotel individually reviews date, number of guests, type of event, catering, technology, music, and any special requirements. Please submit your request directly to your tour operator or the Maril Hotel (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact).
CompanyFAQ.faq-58-q: Does Maril work with tour operators and agencies?
CompanyFAQ.faq-58-a: Yes, Maril works with tour operators, agencies, health travel providers, and booking portals. Partner inquiries are reviewed based on allotments, prices, availability, target group, and contractual terms. Please submit your request directly via our ILPR Maril network page (https://www.ilpr-maril.com/de/netzwerk).
CompanyFAQ.faq-59-q: Are there corporate rates or special rates for business customers?
CompanyFAQ.faq-59-a: Corporate rates or special rates may be available for business customers, project partners, tour operators, groups, or organizations. These are based on travel dates, number of rooms, length of stay, season, desired services, and contractual agreements. Please submit your request directly to our Maril hotel information desk via our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact).
CompanyFAQ.faq-60-q: Can I purchase Maril hotel vouchers or stay vouchers?
CompanyFAQ.faq-60-a: Yes, hotel vouchers or stay vouchers can be purchased from Maril. Please submit a request via our contact page (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact), including relevant details such as period, number of people, room category, restrictions, or the value of the voucher you wish to purchase. We will get back to you promptly.
CompanyFAQ.faq-61-q: Are there loyalty, partner, or guest rates at the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-61-a: The Maril Hotel Didim may offer special rates or discounts depending on season, availability, and current campaigns. Whether loyalty, partner, or group rates are possible should be inquired about directly at the Maril Hotel (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact), via the booking platform, or the tour operator.
CompanyFAQ.faq-62-q: How does Maril protect guests' and prospects' personal data?
CompanyFAQ.faq-62-a: Maril processes personal data in connection with bookings, inquiries, stays, payments, partner processes, and, where applicable, KYC checks. The applicable privacy information and legal requirements are decisive.
CompanyFAQ.faq-63-q: Does Maril have a whistleblower system or compliance contact?
CompanyFAQ.faq-63-a: Yes, Maril maintains a legal section with a whistleblower system and compliance contact. Reports may be submitted by guests, employees, partners, or third parties regarding relevant compliance, safety, or integrity matters. Such cases can be submitted to us via our website (https://www.ilpr-maril.com/de/rechtliches/hinweisgeber).
CompanyFAQ.faq-64-q: How can I contact the Maril Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-64-a: You can reach the Maril Hotel Didim through the hotel's official contact channels, particularly by phone, email, or via the website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact). For faster processing, it is recommended to include travel date, request, room preference, and contact details directly.
CompanyFAQ.faq-65-q: In which languages does Maril support guests at Hotel Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-65-a: Guest support is available in Turkish, English, German, Russian, Chinese, and Arabic, and will soon be expanded to include Italian and Greek. Personal language support at the hotel may vary depending on team, season, and contact person. For specific matters, we recommend a direct inquiry with the hotel before arrival.
CompanyFAQ.faq-66-q: Is the planned Maril Hotel Nice already open?
CompanyFAQ.faq-66-a: No. Nice is presented on the ILPR Maril website as a planned location. The existing hotel location is Didim on the Turkish Aegean coast.
CompanyFAQ.faq-67-q: Is the planned Maril Hotel Miami already open?
CompanyFAQ.faq-67-a: No. Miami is presented on the ILPR Maril website as a planned location. The existing hotel operation should be distinguished from the planned international location in Florida.
CompanyFAQ.faq-68-q: Why is Maril planning further locations besides Didim?
CompanyFAQ.faq-68-a: With the existing Hotel Maril Didim, the Maril Group has a strong starting point for its resort and hospitality concept. This location demonstrates that high-quality recreation, modern hotel operations, and low-barrier infrastructure can be meaningfully combined. That is why ILPR Maril plans to expand the concept to further international destinations such as Nice, Istanbul, and Miami.
CompanyFAQ.faq-69-q: Are the Maril FAQs binding, or are they for general guidance?
CompanyFAQ.faq-69-a: The Maril FAQs are intended for general guidance for guests, prospects, and partners. The specific booking confirmation, concluded contracts, legal notices, and the applicable hotel or offer conditions are always binding.
CompanyFAQ.faq-70-q: Is the Maril Hotel Didim an existing hotel or a planned hotel investment?
CompanyFAQ.faq-70-a: The Maril Hotel Didim is classified as the existing, first Maril location on the Turkish Aegean coast. Further locations such as Nice, along with activities in the USA, will follow once sufficient capital is available and suitable opportunities arise.
CompanyFAQ.faq-71-q: How does Maril generate revenue from hotel and resort operations?
CompanyFAQ.faq-71-a: Maril generates operating revenue primarily from overnight stays, meals, additional services, group bookings, partner programs, and complementary resort, wellness, and health offerings. A particular strength of the concept lies in combining high-quality hotel operations with low-barrier infrastructure for guests with special comfort, mobility, or care needs. This allows Maril to appeal not only to classic vacation guests but also to long-term guests, seniors, health-conscious travelers, and cooperation partners from the care and healthcare sector. The specific revenue structure depends on the respective location, season, occupancy, and booked services.
CompanyFAQ.faq-72-q: What sets Maril apart from classic vacation hotels in Turkey?
CompanyFAQ.faq-72-a: The Maril Hotel Didim combines classic beach vacations with spa, wellness, all-inclusive service, generous room capacity, and family-friendly offerings. What sets it apart is its focus on guests with special comfort, mobility, or care needs, including seniors, people with disabilities, and travelers who value low-barrier infrastructure. The concept is complemented by various room categories, beach and pool areas, as well as meeting and event spaces for special occasions.
CompanyFAQ.faq-73-q: Why is Didim, Turkey, relevant to ILPR Maril as a hotel and resort location?
CompanyFAQ.faq-73-a: Didim is relevant to Maril because the location on the Turkish Aegean coast is tourist-attractive and suitable for vacation hotels, resort operations, and low-barrier stays. The existing location supports the operational credibility of the concept.
CompanyFAQ.faq-74-q: Why is Maril planning additional resorts in Nice on the Côte d'Azur and in Miami?
CompanyFAQ.faq-74-a: Nice and Miami represent internationally renowned hotel and resort markets with a high-quality tourism positioning. For Maril, these locations could contribute to the international expansion of the hospitality and resort concept going forward. Further information is available on our website (https://ilpr-maril.vercel.app/de/unternehmen/standorte).
CompanyFAQ.faq-75-q: Are there project updates, financial information, or operating figures for Maril?
CompanyFAQ.faq-75-a: Maril may compile project updates, operational developments, location information, or relevant publications in a closed, non-public information area, or publish press releases in the public area. Which information is available when, for whom, and in what form depends on the project status, the intended recipient group, and the applicable legal framework.
CompanyFAQ.faq-76-q: Is Maril a hotel or a financial product?
CompanyFAQ.faq-76-a: ILPR MARIL TURIZM ANONIM SIRKETI is the owner of the Maril Hotel in Didim. This company, like ILPR Maril Inc., is led by Semun Oguz. ILPR Maril Inc. has an exclusive contract, based on a share deal model, with ILPR TÜRKIYE AS. This contract allows ILPR Maril Inc. to acquire ILPR MARIL TURIZM ANONIM SIRKETI share by share.
CompanyFAQ.faq-77-q: Who may use Maril investor information, and which countries are excluded?
CompanyFAQ.faq-77-a: Maril investor information may be subject to geographic and regulatory restrictions. Certain countries, groups of individuals, or US persons may be excluded if required for legal, regulatory, or offer-specific reasons, or based on an individual decision by compliance or management.
CompanyFAQ.faq-78-q: Can anyone obtain Maril documents or participation information?
CompanyFAQ.faq-78-a: No, this is not a public offering, nor are these fully voting and dividend-entitled registered shares listed on a stock exchange. Whether documents or participation information can be provided depends on country of residence, legal requirements, investor qualification, confidentiality, individual financial situation, whether an investor already belongs to a known closed investor circle, and internal review. Maril may decline or only partially respond to requests.
CompanyFAQ.faq-79-q: How are Maril shares or investor-related rights documented?
CompanyFAQ.faq-79-a: The documentation of Maril shares or investor-related rights consists of US registered shares of ILPR Maril Inc., Delaware. These are registered with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) under Reg D 506. The shareholder list, as well as the allocation of securities, is managed internally by the issuing company (ILPR Maril Inc.), potentially with the support of a US transfer agent or a US digital shareholder registry provider, and depends on the specific participation structure.
CompanyFAQ.faq-80-q: Does Maril offer fixed distributions or guaranteed returns?
CompanyFAQ.faq-80-a:
There is a planned dividend, currently set at 3.85%. However, it should be noted that wherever there are plans to distribute dividends, there is always a dividend risk. Dividend risk refers to the risk that a company reduces, suspends, or completely cancels its dividend payments to shareholders. Dividends are distributions a company makes to its shareholders, typically paid from company profits, and are approved by the shareholder meeting.

Dividend risk arises when a company is unable to pay expected dividends due to financial difficulties, economic conditions, or other unforeseen factors, or when the majority of shareholders vote against distributing dividends or against the proposed amount.

For investors who rely on dividends as a source of income or pursue a dividend strategy, dividend risk is an important consideration, as a reduction or suspension of dividends can negatively affect their returns. Dividend risk can be influenced by various company-related factors: changes in tax legislation or regulatory requirements can affect a company's ability to pay dividends, or influence the company's decision on whether to distribute dividends.

No, there are no fixed distributions or guaranteed returns. Economic performance depends, among other things, on occupancy, room rates, costs, financing, season, competition, project progress, and legal framework conditions.
CompanyFAQ.faq-81-q: Are there operational benefits for Maril investors or supporters?
CompanyFAQ.faq-81-a: Maril may consider certain operational benefits such as invitations, site visits, special guest rates, or project-related information formats. Such benefits are not a return guarantee and depend on legal permissibility, availability, and the respective program.
CompanyFAQ.faq-82-q: Can investors visit the Maril Hotel Didim in person?
CompanyFAQ.faq-82-a: Yes, a visit to the existing Didim location and other projects is possible for qualified prospects, partners, or investors following prior coordination. Appointments depend on availability, operational schedule, confidentiality, and the respective review process. You can also simply book a room at Maril or in the surrounding area and visit the facilities and grounds at any time, unannounced!
CompanyFAQ.faq-83-q: Does Maril have a financial calendar or regular investor updates?
CompanyFAQ.faq-83-a: A financial calendar and/or regular investor updates are provided to qualified investors and prospects, or made available upon request. The scope depends on project status, recipient group, and regulatory requirements.
CompanyFAQ.faq-84-q: Is the information on the Maril website investment advice?
CompanyFAQ.faq-84-a: No. The information on the Maril website is general information and does not constitute investment, legal, tax, or financial advice. An investment decision requires review of the official documents and is an independent assessment by a qualified prospect. We always recommend consulting qualified, neutral financial advisors before making an investment decision.
CompanyFAQ.faq-85-q: What does it mean that Maril statements can be forward-looking?
CompanyFAQ.faq-85-a: Forward-looking statements refer to expectations, plans, forecasts, or possible developments. Such statements involve uncertainties and may change materially due to market conditions, financing, regulation, operations, construction, demand, or other factors.
CompanyFAQ.faq-86-q: How do I obtain an invoice or booking confirmation for my stay at the Maril Hotel?
CompanyFAQ.faq-86-a: After a booking, guests generally receive a booking confirmation with the key stay details. An invoice or payment confirmation can be requested, depending on the booking channel, payment method, and rate, directly from the hotel or via the relevant booking channel.
CompanyFAQ.faq-87-q: Can I change the name on my Maril booking or add another guest?
CompanyFAQ.faq-87-a: Name changes or additional guests may be reviewed depending on the rate, availability, and booking channel. Guests should communicate changes as early as possible so that room occupancy, guest data, and any additional costs can be properly accounted for.
CompanyFAQ.faq-88-q: What are the benefits of booking directly with the Maril Hotel?
CompanyFAQ.faq-88-a: A direct booking can have the advantage that questions about room preferences, special requirements, meal plans, transfers, or longer stays can be coordinated directly with Maril. The specific prices and conditions depend on date, availability, and the selected rate.
CompanyFAQ.faq-89-q: What services are included in the booked Maril rate?
CompanyFAQ.faq-89-a: The included services depend on the booked rate. Depending on the offer, overnight stay, breakfast, half board, full board, special services, or additional hotel offerings may be included. The details in the booking confirmation are always decisive.
CompanyFAQ.faq-90-q: Can I request a room upgrade at the Maril Hotel?
CompanyFAQ.faq-90-a: Yes. A room upgrade may be reviewed depending on availability, booked category, and stay period. Whether an upgrade is possible and whether additional costs apply will be confirmed individually.
CompanyFAQ.faq-91-q: Can I communicate special requests to Maril before my arrival?
CompanyFAQ.faq-91-a: Yes. Guests can communicate special requests such as room location, bed type, allergies, mobility needs, arrival time, or transfer requirements before arrival. Maril reviews these requests based on availability and organizational feasibility. Please direct these requests to your tour operator, the relevant booking portal, or visit our booking page (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact) based on your booking.
CompanyFAQ.faq-92-q: Can I book a stay at the Maril Hotel for someone else?
CompanyFAQ.faq-92-a: A booking for another person may be possible depending on the booking channel, payment method, and hotel conditions. Correct guest information, reachable contact details, and clarity on who will check in and pay on-site are important.
CompanyFAQ.faq-93-q: Are cribs or extra beds available at the Maril Hotel?
CompanyFAQ.faq-93-a: Cribs or extra beds may be requested depending on room category, availability, and safety requirements. Guests should communicate their needs at the time of booking or before arrival via our website (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact) or the booking platform so Maril can review the options.
CompanyFAQ.faq-94-q: How can Maril's economic development be tracked?
CompanyFAQ.faq-94-a: In principle, it is important first to distinguish between the two current companies (ILPR TÜRKIYE HÜRRIET AS in Turkey and ILPR Maril Inc. in the USA) and the planned, not-yet-built hotel, land, and investment projects. Economic development can primarily be tracked through operating hotel metrics, location information, cost structure, occupancy, average room rates, food and beverage revenue, additional services, project progress, as well as management accounts, balance sheets, and other economic indicators that are publicly available or can be requested. Such information explains hotel operations and is published through relevant press channels as required. Such reports or publications do not, however, replace individual investment advice.
CompanyFAQ.faq-95-q: How does Maril distinguish existing hotel operations from planned location developments?
CompanyFAQ.faq-95-a: The existing Didim location should be distinguished from the status of planned or prospective locations. It is always important whether information relates to ongoing hotel operations, a specific expansion, a future location development, or the situation of the US company.
CompanyFAQ.faq-96-q: What role do occupancy and room rates play for Maril?
CompanyFAQ.faq-96-a: Occupancy and room rates are key factors in hotel operations. Higher occupancy and market-appropriate room rates can improve revenue, while season, competition, travel trends, costs, and location development can influence results.
CompanyFAQ.faq-97-q: What role do booking channels and partners play for Maril's hotel operations?
CompanyFAQ.faq-97-a: Booking channels and partners can influence how guests find, book, and rate the hotel. Direct bookings (https://marilresort.com.tr/de/contact), tour operators, agencies, online portals, group inquiries, and B2B partners can have varying significance for hotel operations depending on location and season.
CompanyFAQ.faq-98-q: What role do service quality and guest experience play for Maril?
CompanyFAQ.faq-98-a: Service quality, accessibility, cleanliness, meals, low-barrier design, guest reviews, and complaint management are important operational factors. They influence perception of our hotel and can indirectly affect bookings, repeat guests, and partner relationships, helping to build and strengthen them.
CompanyFAQ.faq-99-q: What role does sustainability play in the Maril hotel and resort concept?
CompanyFAQ.faq-99-a: Sustainability at Maril can span several areas, such as energy consumption and resource use. We use alternative power, water, waste disposal, and treatment technology. Maril is currently positioning itself, and will continue to do so, with accessibility, lean management hierarchies, and the integration of local suppliers into the operational cycle.
CompanyFAQ.faq-100-q: What documents does ILPR Maril provide on its website?
CompanyFAQ.faq-100-a: On the ILPR Maril website, visitors will find basic information about the company, its locations and business model, the network, the press section, and legal notices. Detailed project, contract, or non-public documents are not published there as a general matter, but may, where provided for, be requested through the official contact, investor, or press channels.
CompanyFAQ.faq-101-q: What location and market factors are important to Maril?
CompanyFAQ.faq-101-a: For Maril, locations are of interest where setting, accessibility, tourist demand, infrastructure, seasonal patterns, and target group structure fit the resort and hospitality concept. The existing Didim location serves as an important reference point: it shows that a high-quality hotel concept combining recreation, comfort, low-barrier infrastructure, and long-term stay offerings can be developed into a highly profitable business at suitable locations. For new locations, Maril therefore particularly examines tourism potential, guest structure, competition, cost structure, local conditions, and suitability for future international scaling.

Contact.title: Get in Touch | ILPR Maril
Contact.description: Get in touch with ILPR Maril now.
Contact.intro: Get in touch with ILPR Maril now.
Contact.h2: Where groups arrive – and feel at home
Contact.p-1: For spa and rehabilitation guests, patients with disabilities, seniors, and health-conscious long-term guests, the Maril Group's properties offer the perfect symbiosis of medically grounded spa offerings and high-quality resort comfort.
Contact.p-2: Our hotels and resorts already have (or have in planning) dedicated wellness and therapy centers with qualified staff, state-of-the-art equipment, and individually tailored treatments: from thalassotherapy to mineral therapy.
Contact.p-3: ILPR Maril Inc. combines medical expertise with year-round availability: doctors, therapists, and nursing staff are available on-site, and administrative processes such as billing with various national and international health insurers are standardized, further easing the stay at our locations.
Contact.p-4: The infrastructure also meets the highest accessibility standards, allowing guests to benefit in particular from wheelchair-accessible pathways, therapeutic pools, fitness programs, and, on request, medical, vegetarian, or vegan diets.
Contact.p-5: Commercial cooperation partners such as specialized spa and medical travel providers, doctors and clinics (LINK TO DOCTORS AND CLINICS HERE), and nursing and care homes (LINK TO NURSING AND CARE HOMES HERE) particularly value working with us for the excellent accessibility and location of our properties, plannable capacities, assured quality, and room and staff capacities optimally adapted to spa and rehabilitation demand.
Contact.p-6: Are you a doctor, or seeking exclusive alternatives for your nursing or care home at the world's most beautiful locations? Learn more about our cooperation models with doctors and clinics, as well as nursing and care homes.

ElderlyCare.title: Spa Guests | ILPR Maril
ElderlyCare.h1: Care without limits. Dignity without compromise.
ElderlyCare.intro: The Maril Group's cooperation model for professional elderly care.
ElderlyCare.h2: Where care and quality of life come together
ElderlyCare.p-1: ILPR Maril Inc. opens up a fundamentally new cooperation model for nursing and care homes, assisted living communities, dementia care networks, and geriatric care facilities: recreation and respite stays in accessible five-star infrastructure – with complete nursing and medical care, far removed from the daily routine of inpatient facilities.
ElderlyCare.p-2: Stays ranging from two weeks to six months are possible – on request with round-the-clock care by qualified local specialist staff: geriatric nurses, physical therapists, general practitioners, chiropractors, and other specialists. Our accessible resorts are already available to cooperation partners at short notice – for example, during waiting periods, renovation phases, staff shortages, or seasonal capacity peaks.

Groups.title: Solutions for Travel Groups | ILPR Maril
Groups.intro: From the Turkish Aegean coast to the Côte d'Azur and Florida: places where inclusion and luxury are not opposites.
Groups.h2: Where groups arrive – and feel at home
Groups.p-1: Whether a corporate trip, school class, sports team, press delegation, or church group – organized travel groups are warmly welcomed and well taken care of at the Maril Group's properties.
Groups.p-2: Our hotels and resorts are specifically designed to meet the needs of group travel: adjoining room blocks, flexible booking modules, seamless transfer coordination, and versatile group catering – including individual menus and consideration of special dietary requests.
Groups.p-3: Every travel group receives a central, multilingual point of contact on-site – from coordinating the group's arrival, through implementing special requests, to a smooth departure. Spacious meeting rooms with state-of-the-art technology, a dedicated shuttle service, and proven structures for group excursions and tours round out the offering.
Groups.p-4: For organizers, this means predictable costs, reliable capacities, and an experienced partner who professionally manages the complexity of international group travel – whether a youth group, senior trip, or corporate event. Our accessible facilities and years of experience with diverse group formats make Maril locations the first choice for tour operators, schools, associations, and companies worldwide.
Groups.p-5: Learn more about our company vision and expansion plans – or get in touch directly with our booking agents.

Investors.title: Investors | ILPR Maril
Investors.intro: ILPR Maril offers institutional investors a range of attractive cooperation models, whether on an asset or equity basis.
Investors.h2: One vision. Three locations. Unlimited possibilities.
Investors.p-1: Institutional investors seeking a particularly attractive and bold way to invest their clients' savings in vacation real estate have come to the right place with ILPR Maril.
Investors.p-2: Our offering is aimed primarily at institutional investors for whom high returns, exclusive locations, excellent build quality, and long-term participation matter more than avoiding vacancy risk, mass tourism in the mid- to low-price segment, and short-term returns.
Investors.p-3: With ILPR, institutional investors have excellent expertise at their side for investments in real estate and tourism, covering everything from project design, land sourcing, financing, construction, and budget management, to operations and the sale of properties – all from a single source.
Investors.p-4: We are particularly proud of our sustainable and accessible approach, which is becoming increasingly central to us, our projects, and our team. All of our planned corporate activity focuses on the principle of sustainable development, as the flora and fauna surrounding our ILPR locations are a valuable intangible asset that we respect.
Investors.benefits-intro: Discover how you benefit as an investor by partnering with ILPR Maril.
Investors.benefit-1-body: With our locations in Turkey, France, and the USA, we cover attractive destinations. High demand is virtually guaranteed as a result.
Investors.benefit-2-body: Accessibility is gaining ever greater importance in our society. With ILPR Maril, you set trends instead of following them.
Investors.benefit-3-body: We deploy our expertise to support you in the best possible way. From concept to completed project, we are by your side.
Investors.benefit-4-body: ILPR Maril stands for vision and predictability. With us, you become part of exciting and attractive projects worldwide.

Jobs.title: Careers | ILPR Maril
Jobs.p-1: At ILPR Maril Inc., we combine performance-based compensation with the highest standard of work-life balance. Our employees receive not only attractive base salaries well above market standard, but also benefit from a comprehensive system of bonuses, individual and team incentives, stock options, and revenue sharing – depending on position, area of responsibility, and company-wide success.
Jobs.p-2: The opportunity to work at our international locations is particularly unique: live and work where others pay a lot of money to vacation – from the sunny Aegean coast, to the glamorous Côte d'Azur, to the tropical regions of Florida. We offer fast career advancement, international careers, and the flexibility to switch between locations or work seasonally on different projects.
Jobs.p-3: Our culture is based on performance, initiative, and team spirit, combined with appreciation for individual lifestyles. Flexible working hours, remote work options at less seasonal locations, 30+ vacation days, and comprehensive training programs are a given.
Jobs.p-4: At the same time, we foster a family-like atmosphere, regular team events, and the opportunity to actively contribute to our social responsibility initiatives.
Jobs.p-5: With us, you can build your career internationally – at a company that gives you the freedom to shape your life the way you want.

Locations.title: Our Locations | ILPR Maril
Locations.intro: ILPR Maril stands for worldwide expansion and cross-regional vision
Locations.p-1: ILPR Maril Inc. is focusing its current and future plans on three target countries and regions: France, Turkey, and the USA. These have for many years been among the most stable and popular tourism markets worldwide.
Locations.p-2: ILPR benefits from millions of international guests each year, well-established tourism infrastructure, and strong appeal to both younger and older tourists as well as spa guests.

ScientificResearch.title: Scientific Papers | ILPR Maril
paragraphs: Doing something truly good while also making a lot of money – how does that work?

Actually, it's not that difficult, but it does require complex infrastructure – and that is exactly what Semun Oguz and Maril have built, enabling the Maril team, its investors, and partners to successfully implement the business model today and continue scaling it nationally and internationally in the future.

Our concept of integrating an accessible health resort with a focus on people with significant physical and cognitive limitations and their families is based not only on years of practical experience, but also on a solid scientific foundation. In this section, we provide a selection of studies, professional publications, and official statistics addressing the health effects of the Mediterranean climate, the sea, and targeted spa stays.

Renowned scientific journals and international institutions provide reliable evidence on how sun, seawater, and a balanced Mediterranean environment can contribute to the recovery of people with physical and cognitive impairments. In addition, current market analyses and official forecasts show the growing importance of accessible travel as well as the positive future outlook for Turkish tourism, particularly along the Aegean coast.

In principle, the model can be explained very simply in a few short sentences – the detailed explanations and economic figures are provided in the scientific publications below: acquiring land and building and operating luxury resorts and hotels is, fundamentally, already a highly profitable business.

However, when the target group includes not only ordinary travelers but also spa guests, long-term visitors, recovery stays, and people with physical and cognitive impairments, both the social benefit and the earning potential are significantly higher. The aging of European, American, Japanese, Turkish, and many other societies, combined with low birth rates (a problem in most industrialized countries) and a rapidly increasing number of lifestyle-related diseases, points to a clearly foreseeable demographic development:
Over the next five years, an immensely growing need for hotels and sanatoriums focused on elderly, mobility-impaired, and care-dependent individuals and their families is to be expected.
Feel free to browse the scientific papers, research articles, and other sources listed here.
